title: Banking Associates
summary: J&K Bank invites online applications from domiciles of the UT of J&K for the recruitment of 1033 Banking Associates. The selection process involves an online examination conducted by IBPS, and selected candidates must serve a minimum of 5 years in their initially allotted zone.
eligibility_bullets: Must be a domicile of the UT of J&K.
Minimum age 20 years, maximum 30 years as of 01-01-2026.
Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
Valid reserved category certificate required at the time of registration.
Apprentices who completed training with J&K Bank are eligible for 1-year age relaxation and 2.5% additional marks.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: Reservation rules as per UT of J&K apply

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official website https://jkb.bank.in/ and navigate to the 'Careers' tab.
Ensure eligibility criteria are met before applying.
Pay the application fee through the online mode to finalize the registration.
Regularly check the website for updates regarding call letters and examination dates.
